title: Top 7 DPDP Consent Managers Built for India’s Privacy-First Enterprise Era
ai_summary: This article profiles eight consent management platforms designed to help Indian businesses comply with the DPDP Act ahead of the May 2027 compliance deadline, which carries penalties of up to ₹250 crore for non-compliance. The platforms covered include Neokred (Blutic), Perfios, Redacto, Consentin by Leegality, Surepass, Complynz, and BigID, each offering varying approaches to consent capture, classification, tracking, and revocation. The article positions consent management as a critical enterprise need given that customer data is typically scattered across CRMs, loan origination systems, marketing stacks, and data warehouses, making it difficult for businesses to track who agreed to what.
